in_marathi.name: Nayana
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nayana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, Nayana means 'eye' or 'vision'. It is a name deeply rooted in Hindu mythology, symbolizing the inner and outer worlds, as the eyes are the windows to the soul and the gateway to the divine.
